title: amygdalus elaeagrifolia subsp. leiocarpa
intro: Amygdalus elaeagrifolia subsp. leiocarpa, commonly known as Korean apricot, is a deciduous shrub or small tree in the rose family native to East Asia. This plant is used in traditional medicine, where it is valued for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, contributing to its potential in treating various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Amygdalus elaeagrifolia subsp. leiocarpa include its ability to protect against cell damage, modulate the immune system, and exhibit neuroprotective effects. The bioactive constituents responsible for these properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which have been identified in the plant's leaves and fruits.
